title: UiKit untyped statement
description: One claim this schema cannot make, with the reason nothing asserts it. `about` is required and drawn from a closed list, so a family of statements can be checked against the contract it is about rather than read one at a time: the conformance suite asks whether every prop the schema cannot type has an entry. `about: prop` additionally names the prop, checked against the extracted prop list the way a deprecation's key is.

about.description: prop: a property that reaches the contract asserting nothing - a generic, a function, a live object, a React node. unexposed_part: internal structure of the primitive underneath that the kit does not expose as a component of its own; a prop the kit does not advertise is named in `withheld`, with its own reason, instead. outside_mount: a mount point outside the kit, which `mounted_in` carries as an outside_mount rather than as a component reference. behaviour: anything the props type never carries - internal state, a runtime relationship, a fact about the component rather than about its schema.

prop.description: Name of a prop declared by the component, not a type id. Checked against the extracted prop list by the conformance test.
